name: com.chikumatateshina.unityassetsoptimizer
description: Non-destructive asset optimizer for VRChat worlds and avatars: texture atlas (incl. lilToon / Poiyomi), material/mesh merge, texture compression, decimation/LOD, Android/iOS variants, VRChat SDK official rank, NDMF build-time mode, with snapshot-based restore and before/predicted/after metrics.
